learning_outcomes.text: Master calculations for complex fluid installations.
Acquire knowledge in subjects related to energy production, both conventional and renewable, enabling the learning of new methods and theories, and providing versatility to adapt to new situations.
Acquire knowledge and skills for the calculation, use, and maintenance of fluid machines and installations.

syllabus_topics: Principles and components of the wind turbine
Control and orientation systems in wind turbines
History and evolution of wind turbines
Measurement and treatment of wind data
Aerodynamic profile of a wind turbine blade
Wind action on an aerodynamic profile
Power flow in a wind turbine
Effect of roughness and erosion on an aerodynamic profile
Preliminary design of a wind turbine
P1. CFD simulation with XFLow of a NACA profile
P2. Experimental calculation of aerodynamic coefficients in a NACA profile

assessment_methods.method: Written exam with theoretical and problem-solving parts
Completion of class problems, practicals, and oral presentations

assessment_rules: The written exam and the completion of class problems, practicals, and oral presentations are recoverable. A minimum grade of 3 out of 10 is required for each assessed component. The final grade is calculated as 70% from the written exam and 30% from the class problems, practicals, and oral presentations.
